route: Risk-removal landing [observed] → Free consultation [observed] → Hearing and strategy [observed] → List and script preparation [observed] → High-volume execution [observed] → Qualified handoff and improvement [observed]
limitations: No se enviaron formularios, no se contactó a la empresa y no se inventaron etapas posteriores al CTA.
No se observó un formulario HTML recuperable; puede cargarse con JavaScript o aparecer después de un CTA.
No se detectó una firma técnica comercial reconocible en scripts, iframes, enlaces o formularios públicos; esto no demuestra que no exista.
No se localizó evidencia legal o de confianza suficientemente legible en las páginas recuperadas; puede existir en otra ruta o jurisdicción.
No se enviaron formularios ni datos personales.
No se contactó con la empresa.
redVitalia: **Adaptar:** una acción principal inequívoca como “無料相談”, manteniendo una sola ruta dominante por landing.
**Adaptar:** convertir la reversión de riesgo visible en una condición contractual medible, no en una promesa ambigua.
**Copiar con control:** presentar casos con cliente, periodo, inversión, denominador y resultado; distinguir siempre datos autodeclarados de auditoría independiente.
**Copiar:** responder objeciones de precio, plazo, permanencia y resultados antes del CTA de alto compromiso.

message.headline: Fully performance-based: no meeting means zero fee
message.promise: Produce qualified appointments with a guaranteed work volume while charging only for delivered meetings.
message.positioning: SCALE Lead combines outcome pricing with auditable activity, trained internal staff and recorded quality evidence.
message.audience: B2B companies seeking measurable outbound meetings · Buyers that value call transparency and activity commitments

forms.friction: The form offered nine service choices and detailed purpose options.

funnel.detail: Performance pricing, zero fixed fees and work volume are stated immediately.
A structured form captures company, service and desired outcome.
Needs, target and approach strategy are defined.
Target lists and talk tracks are prepared before outreach.
At least 500 phone and LinkedIn approaches are promised monthly.
Meetings are ranked, recorded and reported weekly, with monthly PDCA reviews.

contract: Launch target of about two weeks
guarantee: At least 500 approaches per month; no appointment means no performance fee.

proof: Simulation figures were distinguishable from reported results
contradictions: risk-qualification — Financial risk is reduced, but time commitment remains material. — Zero fixed fees and performance pricing suggest minimal commitment. — The FAQ states a six-month contract and case-by-case early termination.

evidence-classification — The evidence system must label simulated and historical outcomes separately. — Numerical simulations and cases appear together. — Simulation values are not actual delivered results.
inferences: Appointment ranking and recordings are intended to prevent disputes over lead quality. — confidence: high — basis: Both controls are prominent next to performance-based billing.
The six-month term protects delivery economics despite the lack of fixed monthly fees. — confidence: medium — basis: The service commits meaningful preparation and a minimum monthly work volume.
notObservable: Exact definition of a billable appointment
limitations: No call recording or dashboard could be inspected.
Case metrics were not independently audited.

copy: Combine outcome pricing with a guaranteed work-volume floor
Separate simulations from real case outcomes
avoid: Using no-risk language without the six-month term beside it
test: A visible quality score and evidence pack for each delivered appointment
